audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart contradicts itself and the data: Kayle wins 54.83% over 518 games, yet the chart hands Mordekaiser Level 1 (where whys[0] itself says the lane is even) and the 2+ item stage (where whys[6] says Kayle shreds him from range).
audit.why: Packet levelChart reads Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Skill / Kayle, which matches the written whys. Levels 4-5 belong to Mordekaiser (whys[3] says concede the window), not Skill.
audit.corrected: Row 0 -> Skill, rows 1-4 Mordekaiser, row 3 Mordekaiser, row 5 Skill, row 6 Kayle. Both layers flipped in matched pairs.

audit.why: Spikes are accurately placed: Mordekaiser at levels 2-3 and 6 (Realm of Death, 140/120/100s), Kayle at 6 (ranged Divine Ascent) and 2+ items (Nashor's-fed ranged autos). All four spikes[] entries exist.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mordekaiser's Q is called 'Mace of Spades' in spikes[0].text and early. Riot's current name is Obliterate. Cooldowns are never stated: Obliterate 8/7/6/5/4s, Indestructible 12/11/10/9/8s, Death's Grasp 16/14/12/10/8s at 700 range.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits authority lists Q = Obliterate. Naming the real ability and its cooldown makes the spacing advice concrete: outside 700 range he has no dash and cannot reach you.
audit.corrected: Use Obliterate (Q) and Indestructible (W); state Death's Grasp's 700 range as the line Kayle must stay outside once ranged.

audit.whatIsWrong: Indestructible converts stored damage into a heal every 8-12s, and the anti-heal requirement is only mentioned in passing.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule needs-antiheal: Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades against his W sustain.
audit.corrected: Executioner's Calling / Oblivion Orb before extended trades; stated in spikes[0] and mid.

audit.why: Divine Judgment invulnerability does not remove Kayle from Realm of Death — the existing text already states this correctly and it is the decisive interaction at 6.

edits.before: You are the weakest level 1 in the game — pay rent quietly. Identify how Mordekaiser contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 you both own nothing — he has no dash and your autos are melee, so last-hit even and stay outside Obliterate's 675 range on the wave.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Realm of Death's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Indestructible eats your Radiant Blast poke and every extended trade refills it — farm at max range, concede CS to Obliterate, wait for 6.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Mordekaiser carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Ranged autos plus E missing-health on-hit shred him from outside Death's Grasp's 700 range — no dash, so he never closes on you.

edits.before: His window: with Q (Mace of Spades) hitting bonus on an isolated target plus W shield-heal, he can walk you down in an extended trade your single W heal and short melee autos cannot answer.
edits.after: His window: Obliterate (Q) hits bonus damage on an isolated target and Indestructible (W) turns the stored damage into a heal every 8-12s, so an extended trade beats your one 15s W — buy Executioner's.

notes: Kit-derived 'grounding' flag on Mordekaiser's Q contradicts Riot's description (damage only, bonus when isolated) — treated as a tooltip-parse misfire and not asserted. diffRating/carryRating both read 8.5/10 and the report calls this a 'Hard matchup' while diff is FAV at 54.83% over 518 games; left alone this pass, but the rating text and the win rate disagree and a human should settle it.
